title: Rochdale’s Owen Webster ready for fresh start in BKFC featherweight clash
excerpt: Rochdale-born Owen Webster says he is ready to “take over the game” ahead of his featherweight bout against Dan Morel at Glasgow’s OVO Hydro on 7 November.
body:
Rochdale-born Owen Webster says he is ready to “take over the game” as he prepares to return to Bare Knuckle Fighting Championship in a new weight class.

Webster is scheduled to face Dan Morel in a featherweight bout at BKFC 96 at Glasgow’s OVO Hydro on Saturday 7 November. The contest is listed on the promotion’s official fight card.

Looking ahead to his return, Webster told supporters: “3 Weeks on Saturday and I make that walk again, totally different fighter whole new weight class but still ready to take over the game.”

His message signals confidence ahead of a change in division, with Webster promising supporters a different version of himself when he steps back into the ring.

For the Rochdale fighter, the Glasgow appearance offers an opportunity to make his mark at featherweight and begin a fresh chapter in his BKFC career.

Morel stands between him and that ambition. BKFC’s official profile lists Morel as a featherweight with a promotional record of no wins, losses or draws ahead of their meeting.

The event marks BKFC’s Scottish debut and is headlined by Conor Cooke defending the UK light heavyweight championship against Sean Weir. Webster’s contest is a featherweight matchup on the card; it is not listed as a title fight.

Supporters can find ticket and viewing information through the official BKFC event page: https://www.bkfc.com/events/bkfc-glasgow

With a new weight class and a determined message to his rivals, Webster will be looking to give his hometown something to celebrate on 7 November.

Sources: Owen Webster’s statement supplied to Rochdale Daily; BKFC’s official event listing and Dan Morel fighter profile; venue event details: https://www.sec.co.uk/events/detail/bare-knuckle-fighting-championship
